allocationLaw: Decision scores prioritize likely speed, leverage, control, cost, compounding, founder minutes, and risk. Real allocation must later use cleared contribution per founder minute from trusted receipts.

channels.rationale: One agency can expose multiple downstream accounts, the sprint is partner-brandable, and delivery does not require replacing the agency's stack.
channels.minimumExperiment: A bounded list of evidence-qualified agencies; five qualified conversations maximum before price/offer review.
channels.killThreshold: No paid pilot after five qualified conversations, or partner support/discount burden destroys positive contribution.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Accepted downstream pack -> permissioned proof -> additional site -> recurring assurance monitor.

channels.rationale: A safe public-surface checklist or limited read-only diagnostic can demonstrate the evidence method and create a shareable artifact without sending on the buyer's behalf.
channels.minimumExperiment: One precise diagnostic tied to the canary; no generic calculator or fabricated revenue-loss estimate.
channels.killThreshold: No qualified usage or buyer conversation after a predeclared observation window.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Diagnostic evidence is naturally forwarded to the agency/client and terminates in the paid sprint.

channels.rationale: Precise evidence-led outreach can test the specific offer quickly, but current domains have no provider/registrar receipt, zero verified mailboxes, no sender history, and no approved live campaign.
channels.minimumExperiment: Only after activation gates: a jurisdiction-gated, suppression-checked, low-volume canary with public-contact provenance.
channels.killThreshold: Pause on provenance, suppression, policy, DNS, sender-health, hard-bounce, or complaint failure; commercial kill after the bounded sample has no qualified conversation.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Each response and disposition improves audience and evidence only when linked to eventual payment and acceptance.

channels.rationale: Evidence-backed buyer questions and diagnostic explanations can compound without sender reputation, but feedback to payment is slower.
channels.minimumExperiment: One buyer question -> one original evidence asset -> one safe diagnostic or offer path -> attributed qualified usage.
channels.killThreshold: Park topics that have no buyer question, proof utility, qualified use, or offer path.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Evergreen evidence asset -> search/answer discovery -> diagnostic -> qualified partner/buyer.

channels.rationale: Public directories can locate agencies with visible vertical specialization, but presence in a directory is neither permission nor demand.
channels.minimumExperiment: Use directories for account evidence and public-contact provenance only; no automated scraping beyond applicable terms.
channels.killThreshold: Reject sources with unclear terms, weak identity, no downstream-account evidence, or high manual research burden.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Partner taxonomy and specialization evidence improve targeting across motions.

channels.rationale: Read-only diagnostic distribution can reduce friction and live inside partner workflows, but a public integration before repeated paid use would productize too early.
channels.minimumExperiment: After repeated paid delivery, expose one read-only, versioned, permission-scoped diagnostic contract.
channels.killThreshold: Do not publish a generic company-control MCP server or any write-capable public tool without separate authority design and demand proof.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Partner workflow invocation -> evidence pack -> paid remediation/monitoring path.

channels.rationale: Marketplaces can provide discovery and billing leverage, but approval, platform dependence, support, and productization burden are premature before recurring paid demand.
channels.minimumExperiment: None before at least three repeated accepted paid deliveries and a stable shared integration contract.
channels.killThreshold: Reject exclusive lock-in, unsupported claims, unprofitable revenue share, or premature platform build.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Marketplace discovery -> install -> diagnostic -> recurring assurance, only after the product exists.

channels.rationale: This is likely the strongest long-run channel because successful evidence delivery can reveal adjacent sites and partners, but UberBond has no customer or accepted delivery today.
channels.minimumExperiment: Ask only after accepted paid delivery and explicit customer permission.
channels.killThreshold: Never infer referral permission from satisfaction, usage, or payment.
channels.compoundingMechanism: Accepted result -> permissioned introduction -> second downstream account -> renewal/expansion.

channels.rationale: Paid acquisition has no measured funnel, no cleared contribution, no budget authority, and slower evidence quality than a bounded partner or outbound probe.
channels.minimumExperiment: None until at least three accepted paid deliveries and an authorized payback ceiling exist.
channels.killThreshold: Remain disabled without explicit budget authority and measured positive contribution.

reallocationRule: No channel outranks another economically until trusted cleared-payment outcomes include delivery acceptance, variable cost, and founder minutes. Until then, this portfolio controls research and bounded preparation only.
